title: 5.14.4 Debugging: The snake that never grows
description: Two planted bugs. The snake moves and leaves no body behind, and when it does grow the tail pops off immediately.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: The head steps across the grid alone: the body array is never added to.

steps.title: Bug 1: the old cell is never kept
steps.instructions: Before moving, `body.unshift({ x: headX, y: headY })`.

steps.title: Bug 2: the tail is dropped every step
steps.instructions: `body.pop()` runs unconditionally, so the snake can never be longer than one. Only pop when it should NOT grow (or when it is longer than the target length).

requirements.title: The old cell is kept
requirements.description: The head's previous cell is added to the body array each step. Help: 5.14.1 (Reading: A body that grows)

requirements.title: The tail is not always dropped
requirements.description: pop() (or an equivalent) is not unconditional; growth is possible. Help: 5.14.1 (Reading: A body that grows)
